lines.text: Here is the receipt for running a boarding house.
The Fe Galang Da Silva Boarding House, in Legazpi City. Thirty-three units, thirty-two lived in.
Before. Her income and expenses, on one USB drive. The only copy.
Invoices, in a paper book. Rent, in cash. Repairs, in a chat. Inquiries, nowhere.
Her ledger, in her own layout. Her invoice numbers, checked for repeats.
GCash, verified by her. Repairs, from request to done. Inquiries, with no account.
Nine hundred thirty-seven records, moved in. Security, A-plus. Quality, four point five three, out of five.
